title: +*WORLD HISTORY I: ANCIENT CIVILIZATIONS
description: Presents a survey of the global human development from roughly the dawn of humans to 1000 CE. Identifies the main historical forces that shaped the human experience and highlights the monumental innovations that changed the way ancient humans lived. Explores connections and disconnections across geographic, social, and cultural barriers.
